In one sentence: what is the significance of the Bullet Cluster for dark matter?

In the Bullet Cluster (1E 0657-56), the total mass mapped by weak gravitational lensing sits apart from the hot X-ray gas, which holds most of the ordinary matter, so most of the mass must be collisionless, non-baryonic dark matter rather than an effect of modified gravity (Clowe et al. 2006, arXiv:astro-ph/0608407).
